note: Layout treatments for the offer-first text layer: WHERE the text goes. Typography and effects come from offer-styles.json and colour from offer-palettes.json, so any treatment can be combined with any style and palette. Blocks are stacked inside a fixed region: each is fitted to its share of the region, then the stack is laid out from the anchor edge using real rendered heights, so no text can leave the region.

t1-bottom-stack.name: Bottom stack
t1-bottom-stack.visual_hint: Keep the lower half of the frame darker and visually uncluttered; place the subject in the upper half. No text, letters, signage, logos or watermarks anywhere.
t1-bottom-stack.hierarchy: duration is the largest line; location is at least as large as audience
